data.summary: Explored accessible APIs and potential domains. Found 10 accessible APIs (Stack Exchange, Crossref, arXiv, GitHub, FDA, EIA, World Bank, PubMed, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar) and 2 inaccessible (ClinicalTrials.gov, USDA). All prediction tasks considered are well-studied areas. Mission has closed 7 candidate directions. Need fundamentally different approach.
